thread:
nisha: FYI — Venator wants to run a short evaluation next week for their search assistant. They plan to bring a vendor model 'venator-bert-14k-custom' (hf://venator/bert-14k) and asked for latency/cost expectations plus any security blockers. POC window = 2 weeks. cc @ben @oliver
ben: ack. key asks: 1) can runtime serve that model quantized (q4_0 / q8) + prefix KV caching? 2) rough per-1M-token cost for Hosted vs Dedicated?
ar ايضا: (typo) sorry ignore
oliver: @ben I ran a quick metadata check — model uses 14k context and custom tokenizer. We need to validate tokenization parity and patch our tokenizer adapter if mismatches. Also confirm export to GGML/ONNX?
sally: infra note — our current q4 path supports up to 12k sequences without re-chunking. 14k will need sliding-window or KV spill. That adds latency. If they can limit active prompt to ~8k we can hit desired p50.
raj: runtime estimate (very rough): q4_0 + KV spill → baseline per-token latency +0.9ms compared to 12k baseline. For 8k working set on A100, p50 token latency ≈ 180–240ms depending on batching. If they need <250ms we can try Dedicated pool at steady concurrency 50 qps.
maria: security checklist — does Venator plan to upload PII/PHI? If yes we need a data processing addendum and to ensure KMS usage for any retained caches. Also send us their SOC2 + any third-party model vendor SLA.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/secq/venator-2026 — please fill Q1-6 (data retention, encrypt-at-rest, KMS) by EOD. :lock:
ariana: Pricing question from AE — if they commit 2x dedicated workers for 30 days, what delta vs Hosted? Ben?
ben: quick delta estimate: Hosted (on-demand, quant+kv) ≈ $1200 / 1M tokens (ballpark for large context). Dedicated reserved (1-month, 2 workers) amortized → ~40–55% cheaper depending on utilization. Will confirm with finance for firm quote.
oliver: ops ask — we should run a compatibility scan: tokenizer parity check, attention kernel shape check, and a small perf run on our staging cluster. I can run the tokenizer pass and small inference smoke test tomorrow. Need model artifacts (weights + tokenizer) or HF link.
nisha: Action items: 1) @oliver run tokenizer parity + smoke test (by 2026-04-05). 2) @raj provide rough perf numbers for Dedicated vs Hosted under 8k vs 14k scenarios. 3) @maria confirm if DPA needed and list docs Venator must share. 4) @ben/finance produce provisional pricing by EOD tomorrow. 5) fill sec questionnaire: sec-bot link.
raj: I'll also include a note on KV spill workaround (streaming KV eviction + chunking) and a tradeoff table (latency vs cost).
maria: If they will feed PHI, we should recommend Private deployment (VPC) + HSM KMS. I'll draft verbiage for the PO.
ben: I'll ping finance and Legal. If Venator can accept a short A/B test on Hosted first, we can reduce ramp time.
nisha: Perfect. Oliver — send me the tokenizer smoke-test output and the small perf logs; I'll attach to the deal doc. :+1:
